title: fuzz: nightly CI job must execute the standalone harnesses (zephyr-fuzz job discovers zero tests)
description: Child of b7z9.50 (after the fuzz_schc fix child lands). .github/workflows/fuzz.yml zephyr-fuzz job runs 'west twister -T lichen/tests/fuzz -p native_sim' but lichen/tests/fuzz is a STANDALONE host CMake project (no find_package(Zephyr), no testcase.yaml) — twister discovers zero tests, so the three parser harnesses never execute in CI (R-APPC-013 violation). Also twister route is impractical: harnesses are host libFuzzer/standalone binaries, not Zephyr apps. Fix: replace/augment the job with a direct standalone build+run: cmake lichen/tests/fuzz -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang && cmake --build && execute each harness briefly (standalone mains take argv/stdin — check FUZZ_STANDALONE contract in the harnesses) with a timeout + crash artifact upload; sanitizers.conf's ASan/UBSAN policy is satisfied by the build's -fsanitize=address,undefined (document the mapping in the job or a comment citing R-APPC-009/013). CI yml is not locally verifiable — keep the exact commands identical to the locally-verified ones from the fix child's evidence. Optional follow-up child: PR-gated smoke fuzz run in ci.yml. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.50.
